description.en:
This dataset contains the triples linking the LASLA corpus to the LiLa LemmaBank.
The LASLA Latin corpus consists of a large amount of texts of Classical Latin, semi-automatically lemmatized and annotated with morphosyntactic information, with full manual verification.

full_download.title: LASLA corpus in LiLa
full_download.description: GitHub page of the project. The data are distributed as RDF (Turtle serialization), but they are also available as SQL dump of a relational database
